title.zh: 卷十七 本紀第十七 世宗一
title.raw: 卷十七 本紀第十七 世宗一 Volume 17 Annals 17: Shizong 1

sentences.zh: 【世宗一】

translations.literal: Shizong I.
translations.idiomatic: Annals: Shizong I.

sentences.zh: 世宗，欽天履道英毅神聖宣文廣武洪仁大孝肅皇帝，諱厚熜，憲宗孫也。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor, Venerating Heaven, Treading the Way, Heroic and Resolute, Divine and Sagacious, Expanding in Culture, Extensive in Martial Achievement, Great in Benevolence, Great in Filial Piety, and Reverent, taboo name Houcong, was the Xianzong Emperor's grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong—honored after death as one who venerated Heaven, trod the Way, and united heroic resoluteness, divine sagacity, expansive culture, extensive martial achievement, great benevolence, great filial piety, and reverence—was named Zhu Houcong and was the grandson of Emperor Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 父興獻王祐杬，國安陸，正德十四年薨。

translations.literal: His father was Prince Xing, Zhu Youyuan, who held Anlu as his estate; he died in Zhengde year fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: His father was Prince Xing, Zhu Youyuan, who held Anlu as his fief; he died in Zhengde fourteen.

sentences.zh: 帝年十有三，以世子理國事。

translations.literal: When the Emperor was thirteen, as heir of the estate he administered state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At thirteen he managed the fief as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月辛酉，未除服，特命襲封。

translations.literal: In year sixteen, third month, day xinyou, before mourning dress had been removed, he was specially ordered to succeed to the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Zhengde sixteen, on xinyou, before mourning was complete, he was specially ordered to succeed to the princely title.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，武宗崩，無嗣，慈壽皇太后與大學士楊廷和定策，遣太監谷大用、韋彬、張錦，大學士梁儲，定國公徐光祚，駙馬都尉崔元，禮部尚書毛澄，以遺詔迎王于興邸。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Wuzong Emperor died without heirs; the Empress Dowager Cishou and Grand Secretary Yang Tinghe settled on a plan and dispatched the eunuchs Gu Dayong, Wei Bin, and Zhang Jin, Grand Secretary Liang Chu, the Duke of Dingguo Xu Guangzuo, Chief Commandant of Cavalry Cui Yuan, and Minister of Rites Mao Cheng, to welcome the Prince at the Xing residence by testamentary decree.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Emperor Wuzong died without heirs. Empress Dowager Cishou and Grand Secretary Yang Tinghe chose a successor and sent the eunuchs Gu Dayong, Wei Bin, and Zhang Jin, Grand Secretary Liang Chu, Duke of Dingguo Xu Guangzuo, Chief Commandant of Cavalry Cui Yuan, and Minister of Rites Mao Cheng to bring the prince from his residence at Xing by testamentary decree.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，發安陸。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, day guiwei, he set out from Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei, he departed from Anlu.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，至京師，止於郊外。

translations.literal: On guimao, he reached the capital and halted in the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he reached the capital and stopped in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 禮官具儀，請如皇太子即位禮。

translations.literal: Ritual officials prepared ceremonies and requested that the enthronement follow crown prince succession rites.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials drafted the ceremony and asked that his accession follow the rites prescribed for a crown prince.

sentences.zh: 王顧長史袁宗皋曰：「遺詔以我嗣皇帝位，非皇子也。

translations.literal: The Prince turned to Chief Administrator Yuan Zonggao and said: "The testament appoints me to succeed to the imperial throne, not as an imperial son.
translations.idiomatic: The prince turned to his chief administrator Yuan Zonggao and said, "The testament names me to succeed to the throne, not as an imperial prince.

sentences.zh: 」大學士楊廷和等請如禮臣所具儀，由東安門入居文華殿，擇日登極。

translations.literal: " Grand Secretaries Yang Tinghe and others requested that he follow the rituals the officials had prepared, enter through the East Gate and dwell in the Wenhua Hall, and choose a day to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretaries led by Yang Tinghe asked that he follow the rites the officials had drawn up—enter through the East Gate, take residence in Wenhua Hall, and ascend the throne on a chosen day.

sentences.zh: 不允。

translations.literal: It was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 會皇太后趣群臣上箋勸進，乃即郊外受箋。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager urged the ministers to submit memorials to encourage his accession, he thereupon received the memorials in the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager pressed the ministers to submit memorials urging his accession, he accepted them in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 是日日中，入自大明門，遣官告宗廟社稷，謁大行皇帝几筵，朝皇太后，出禦奉天殿，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: That day at midday, he entered through the Great Ming Gate, dispatched officials to announce at the ancestral temples and altars of soil and grain, paid respects at the deceased emperor's mourning couch, attended upon the empress dowager, emerged to preside at the Hall of Upholding Heaven, and assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: That day at noon he entered through the Great Ming Gate, sent officers to announce his accession at the ancestral temples and the altars of soil and grain, paid respects before the late emperor's mourning couch, attended upon the empress dowager, came forth to preside at the Hall of Upholding Heaven, and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 以明年為嘉靖元年，大赦天下。

translations.literal: The coming year was made Jiajing year one; great pardon under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The following year was declared the first year of the Jiajing reign and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 恤錄正德中言事罪廢諸臣，賜天下明年田租之半，自正德十五年以前逋賦盡免之。

translations.literal: Officials who had remonstrated in the Zhengde reign and been dismissed for crimes were shown mercy and restored; half the next year's field tax was granted to the realm; and all arrears in levies before Zhengde fifteen were remitted in full.
translations.idiomatic: Officials punished for remonstrance during the Zhengde reign were restored to favor; the realm was granted half the next year's field taxes; and all tax arrears dating before Zhengde fifteen were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使奉迎母妃蔣氏。

translations.literal: On bingwu, envoys were dispatched to escort his mother, Consort Jiang, in reverence.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he sent envoys to escort his mother, Lady Jiang, to the capital.

sentences.zh: 召費宏復入閣。

translations.literal: Fei Hong was summoned back into the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Hong was recalled to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命禮臣集議興獻王封號。

translations.literal: On wushen, ritual officials were ordered to assemble and deliberate on Prince Xing's title of honor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he ordered ritual officials to convene and debate titles for Prince Xing.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，罷大理銀礦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao, the Dali silver mines were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao, the Dali silver mines were shut down.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，梁儲致仕。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Liang Chu retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Liang Chu retired.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，吏部侍郎袁宗皋為禮部尚書兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: On renxu, Vice Minister of Personnel Yuan Zonggao was made Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Yuan Zonggao, vice minister of personnel, was made minister of rites and Wenyuan grand secretary and entered deliberations on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬申，強尼伏誅。

translations.literal: On renshen, the strong Buddhist nun was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen a powerful Buddhist nun was put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，江彬伏誅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi, Jiang Bin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, Jiang Bin was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙未，縱內苑禽獸，令天下毋得進獻。

translations.literal: On yiwei, birds and beasts of the inner parks were released, and the realm was ordered not to present any.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the birds and beasts of the imperial parks were set free, and the realm was forbidden to send further tribute of wild creatures.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，革錦衣衛冒濫軍校三萬餘人。

translations.literal: On dingyou, more than thirty thousand fraudulently enrolled officers and soldiers of the Jinyiwei were eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou more than thirty thousand fraudulently enrolled Jinyiwei officers and soldiers were struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，振江西災。

translations.literal: On wuxu, relief was extended for disaster in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu relief was sent to disaster-stricken Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，革傳升官。

translations.literal: On renyin, the practice of promotion by transmission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin transmitted promotions were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，振遼東饑。

translations.literal: On guimao, relief was extended for famine in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao famine relief was sent to Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，進士張璁言，繼統不繼嗣，請尊崇所生，立興獻王廟于京師。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, day renzi, Jinshi Zhang Cong stated that succession was to the line, not to the heirship; he requested honoring his actual parents and establishing a temple to Prince Xing in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renzi, newly passed jinshi Zhang Cong argued that the throne passed by succession to the line, not by adoption as heir; he urged honoring the emperor's biological parents and building a temple to Prince Xing in the capital.

sentences.zh: 初，禮臣議考孝宗，改稱興獻王皇叔父，援宋程頤議濮王禮以進，不允。

translations.literal: Earlier, ritual officials had deliberated on treating Xiaozong as the Emperor's father and changing Prince Xing's title to Imperial Uncle Father; they cited Song dynasty Cheng Yi's treatise on the Prince of Pu rites in advancing it; it was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier ritual officials had proposed treating Xiaozong as the emperor's ritual father and retitling Prince Xing as Imperial Uncle Father, invoking Song Neo-Confucian Cheng Yi's debate over the Prince of Pu; the throne refused.

sentences.zh: 至是，下璁奏，命廷臣集議。

translations.literal: At this time, Zhang's memorial was transmitted downward, and court ministers were ordered to assemble and deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: At this juncture Zhang Cong's memorial was circulated and the court was ordered to debate it.

sentences.zh: 楊廷和等抗疏力爭，皆不聽。

translations.literal: Yang Tinghe and others submitted urgent memorials and argued forcefully; all were ignored.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tinghe and others submitted forceful memorials of protest, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命自今親喪不得奪情，著為令。

translations.literal: On guichou, it was ordered that from now on, mourning for parents could not be cut short by recall to office, and this was established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the throne ordered that hereafter no official could be recalled from parent mourning before the mourning period ended—a rule written into law.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，小王子犯莊浪，指揮劉爵禦卻之。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Little Prince raided Zhuanglang; Commander Liu Jue repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Little Prince struck Zhuanglang; Commander Liu Jue drove him back.

sentences.zh: 丙子，革錦衣衛所及監局寺廠司庫、旗校、軍士、匠役投充新設者，凡十四萬八千餘人。

translations.literal: On bingzi, those newly enrolled in the Jinyiwei posts and in supervisory bureaus, temples, factories, granaries, banner guards, soldiers, artisans, and corvée labor—one hundred forty-eight thousand persons in all—were eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi one hundred forty-eight thousand fraudulently enrolled personnel in the Jinyiwei and its subordinate bureaus, temples, factories, granaries, and the like were struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，寧津盜起。

translations.literal: On dingchou, bandits rose at Ningjin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou bandits rose in Ningjin.

sentences.zh: 德平知縣龔諒死之。

translations.literal: Gong Liang, magistrate of Deping, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Liang, magistrate of Deping, was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，袁宗皋卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yimao, Yuan Zonggao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao, Yuan Zonggao died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，葬毅皇帝于康陵。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Yidi Emperor was buried at Kangling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the late Emperor Yidi was buried at Kangling.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯朔，追尊父興獻王為興獻帝，祖母憲宗貴妃邵氏為皇太后，母妃為興獻后。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, new moon on day jimao, his father Prince Xing was posthumously honored as Emperor Xing; his grandmother, Xianzong's Noble Consort Shao, as Empress Dowager; and his mother as Empress Xing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon of jimao, the emperor posthumously honored his father as Emperor Xing, his grandmother—the Xianzong emperor's Noble Consort Shao—as empress dowager, and his mother as Empress Xing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，興獻后至自安陸。

translations.literal: On renwu, Empress Xing arrived from Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Empress Xing arrived from Anlu.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，振江西災。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengxu, relief was extended for disaster in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengxu, relief was sent again to disaster-stricken Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，錄平宸濠功，封王守仁新建伯。

translations.literal: On dingsi, merit in pacifying Chenhao was recorded; Wang Shouren was enfeoffed as Baron of Xinjian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court rewarded those who suppressed Chenhao's rebellion; Wang Shouren was enfeoffed as Baron of Xinjian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，乾清宮成。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Palace of Heavenly Purity was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Palace of Heavenly Purity was completed.

sentences.zh: 罷廣西貢香。

translations.literal: Guangxi tribute of incense was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute incense from Guangxi was abolished.

sentences.zh: 諭各鎮巡守備官，凡額外之征悉罷之。

translations.literal: The various grand coordinators, military inspectors, and garrison commanders were instructed that all extralegal levies were to be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinators, patrol commanders, and garrison officers were ordered to abolish all levies beyond the statutory quotas.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年春正月癸丑，享太廟。

translations.literal: In spring of Jiajing year one, first month, day guichou, the Grand Temple was served.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Jiajing one, on guichou, the emperor offered at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 己未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Altar.

sentences.zh: 清甯宮後殿災。

translations.literal: The rear hall of the Qingning Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: Fire destroyed the rear hall of the Qingning Palace.

sentences.zh: 命稱孝宗皇考，慈壽皇太后聖母，興獻帝后為本生父母。

translations.literal: It was ordered that Xiaozong be called Imperial Father, Empress Dowager Cishou be called Holy Mother, and Emperor Xing and Empress Xing be called actual birth parents.
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed Xiaozong as ritual father, Empress Dowager Cishou as holy mother, and Emperor Xing and Empress Xing as the emperor's biological parents.

sentences.zh: 己巳，甘州兵亂，殺巡撫都御史許銘。

translations.literal: On jisi, troops at Ganzhou mutinied and killed Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Xu Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi soldiers at Ganzhou mutinied and killed Xu Ming, grand coordinator and censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，耕耤田。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jimao, the plowing ceremony was performed at the Sacred Field.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jimao, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，弗提衛獻生豹，卻之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinhai, Futti guard presented a live leopard; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai, the Futti Guard sent a live leopard as tribute; the court refused it.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，釋奠于先師孔子。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the libation sacrifice was performed to the Prior Master Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the emperor offered the libation sacrifice to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上慈壽皇太后尊號曰昭聖慈壽皇太后，武宗皇后曰莊肅皇后。

translations.literal: On dingsi, honorific titles were raised for Empress Dowager Cishou as Empress Dowager Zhaosheng Cishou, and for the Wuzong Emperor's empress as Empress Zhuangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court raised honorific titles: Empress Dowager Cishou became Empress Dowager Zhaosheng Cishou, and Wuzong's empress became Empress Zhuangsu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上皇太后尊號曰壽安皇太后，興獻后曰興國太后。

translations.literal: On wuwu, honorific titles were raised for the empress dowager as Empress Dowager Shouan, and for Empress Xing as Empress Dowager Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the court raised further honorifics: the empress dowager became Empress Dowager Shouan and Empress Xing became Empress Dowager Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，命各邊巡按御史三年一閱軍馬器械。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renchen, touring censors in each frontier were ordered to inspect troops, horses, and equipment once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renchen, frontier touring censors were ordered to inspect troops, horses, and arms every three years.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，以南畿、浙江、江西、湖廣、四川旱，詔撫按官講求荒政。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiyou, because the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, and Sichuan suffered drought, an edict ordered grand coordinators and touring censors to seek out famine relief measures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, drought in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, and Sichuan prompted an edict ordering provincial officials to devise famine relief policies.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，立皇后陳氏。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinwei, Empress Chen was installed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, Lady Chen was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，振南畿、湖廣、江西、廣西災，免稅糧有差。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinmao, relief was extended for disasters in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Guangxi; tax and grain levies were remitted in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao, relief was sent to disaster-stricken areas in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Guangxi, and tax and grain levies were remitted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以災傷敕群臣修省。

translations.literal: On renchen, because of disaster and damage, the ministers were commanded to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the emperor ordered his ministers to examine themselves in the wake of natural disaster.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，壽安皇太后崩。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, Empress Dowager Shouan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, Empress Dowager Shouan died.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuyin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 振陝西被寇及山東礦賊流劫者。

translations.literal: Relief was extended for those in Shaanxi who had been raided and for roving bandits among Shandong mine workers.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was sent to Shaanxi victims of raiding and to areas ravaged by roving Shandong mine bandits.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅朔，兩畿、河南、山東、陝西同時地震。

translations.literal: In spring of year three, first month, new moon on day bingyin, the Two Metropolitan Regions, Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi all quaked at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Jiajing three, on the new moon of bingyin, earthquakes struck the Two Metropolitan Regions, Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi simultaneously.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，南京刑部主事桂萼請改稱孝宗皇伯考，下廷臣議。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Nanjing Ministry of Justice Director Gui E requested changing Xiaozong's title to Imperial Uncle Father; it was transmitted to court ministers for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Gui E, a director in the Nanjing Ministry of Justice, proposed retitling Xiaozong as Imperial Uncle Father; the memorial was sent to the court for debate.

sentences.zh: 是月，朵顏入寇。

translations.literal: That month, the Tatars of Duoyan raided.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Tatars of Duoyan raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，楊廷和致仕。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingwu, Yang Tinghe retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingwu, Yang Tinghe retired.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，南京地震。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Nanjing quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an earthquake struck Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，振淮、揚饑。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renshen, relief was extended for famine in Huai and Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen, famine relief was sent to Huai and Yang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，振河南饑。

translations.literal: On xinsi, relief was extended for famine in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi famine relief was sent to Henan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，上昭聖皇太后尊號曰昭聖康惠慈壽皇太后。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiyou, honorific titles were raised for Empress Dowager Zhaosheng as Empress Dowager Zhaosheng Kanghui Cishou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, the court raised Empress Dowager Zhaosheng's honorific to Empress Dowager Zhaosheng Kanghui Cishou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上興國太后尊號曰本生聖母章聖皇太后。

translations.literal: On gengxu, honorific titles were raised for Empress Dowager Xingguo as Holy Mother of Actual Birth, Empress Dowager Zhangsheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the court raised Empress Dowager Xingguo's honorific to Actual-Birth Holy Mother, Empress Dowager Zhangsheng.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，追尊興獻帝為本生皇考恭穆獻皇帝，大赦。

translations.literal: On guichou, Emperor Xing was posthumously honored as Actual-Birth Imperial Father, the Gongmu Xian Emperor; great pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the emperor posthumously honored his father as Actual-Birth Imperial Father, Emperor Gongmu Xian, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，編修鄒守益請罷興獻帝稱考立廟，下錦衣衛獄。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Compiler Zou Shouyi requested abolishing calling Emperor Xing Imperial Father and establishing a temple; he was sent to Jinyiwei prison.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Compiler Zou Shouyi memorialized to abolish the title of imperial father for Emperor Xing and tear down his temple; he was cast into Jinyiwei prison.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，蔣冕致仕。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yichou, Jiang Mian retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yichou, Jiang Mian retired.

sentences.zh: 修撰呂柟言大禮未正，下錦衣衛獄。

translations.literal: Compiler Lü Cong stated that the Great Rites were not yet corrected; he was sent to Jinyiwei prison.
translations.idiomatic: Compiler Lü Cong argued that the Great Rites remained unsettled; he was cast into Jinyiwei prison.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣使迎獻皇帝神主于安陸。

translations.literal: On dingchou, envoys were dispatched to escort the spirit tablet of Emperor Xian from Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the court sent envoys to bring the spirit tablet of Emperor Xian from Anlu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，吏部尚書石珤兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: On jimao, Minister of Personnel Shi Hu was additionally made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Minister of Personnel Shi Hu entered the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 六月，御史段續、陳相請正席書、桂萼罪，吏部員外郎薛蕙上《為人後解》，鴻臚少卿胡侍言張璁等議禮之失，俱下獄。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Censors Duan Xu and Chen Xiang requested punishing Xi Shu and Gui E; Ministry of Personnel Director Xue Hui submitted "An Explication of Being Another's Heir"; Vice Director of the Court of State Ceremonial Hu Shi stated the errors in Zhang Cong and others' ritual deliberations; all were sent to prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Censors Duan Xu and Chen Xiang called for punishing Xi Shu and Gui E; Personnel Director Xue Hui submitted his treatise An Explication of Being Another's Heir; Court of State Ceremonial Vice Director Hu Shi denounced the ritual errors of Zhang Cong and his allies; all were imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，更定章聖皇太后尊號，去本生之稱。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on yihai, the honorific title of Empress Dowager Zhangsheng was revised, removing the designation of actual birth.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai, the court revised Empress Dowager Zhangsheng's honorific, stripping the words "actual birth."

sentences.zh: 戊寅，廷臣伏闕固爭，下員外郎馬理等一百三十四人錦衣衛獄。

translations.literal: On wuyin, court ministers prostrated themselves at the palace gate and argued firmly; one hundred thirty-four persons including Director Ma Li were sent to Jinyiwei prison.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin court ministers knelt at the palace gate in fierce protest; one hundred thirty-four officials led by Director Ma Li were cast into Jinyiwei prison.

sentences.zh: 癸未，杖馬理等於廷，死者十有六人。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Ma Li and others were beaten with rods at court; sixteen died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Ma Li and the others were flogged at court; sixteen died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，奉安獻皇帝神主于觀德殿。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the spirit tablet of Emperor Xian was respectfully installed in the Guande Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the spirit tablet of Emperor Xian was installed in the Guande Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，毛紀致仕。

translations.literal: On jichou, Mao Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Mao Ji retired.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，杖修撰楊慎，檢討王元正，給事中劉濟、安磐、張漢卿、張原，御史王時柯於廷。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Compilers Yang Shen and Wang Yuanzheng, Supervising Secretaries Liu Ji, An Pan, Zhang Hanqing, and Zhang Yuan, and Censor Wang Shike were beaten with rods at court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Compiler Yang Shen, Compiler Wang Yuanzheng, supervising secretaries Liu Ji, An Pan, Zhang Hanqing, and Zhang Yuan, and Censor Wang Shike were flogged at court.

sentences.zh: 原死，慎等戍謫有差。

translations.literal: Zhang Yuan died; Yang Shen and others were banished to border garrison in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuan died; Yang Shen and the others were exiled to frontier service in varying grades.

sentences.zh: 是月，免南畿、河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, tax and grain levies were remitted in disaster-stricken areas of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month tax and grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken parts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Henan.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，大同兵變，殺巡撫都御史張文錦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guisi, troops at Datong mutinied and killed Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Zhang Wenjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, soldiers at Datong mutinied and killed Zhang Wenjin, grand coordinator and censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，吏部侍郎賈詠為禮部尚書兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: On yimao, Vice Minister of Personnel Jia Yong was made Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Vice Minister of Personnel Jia Yong was made minister of rites and Wenyuan grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，定稱孝宗為皇伯考，昭聖皇太后為皇伯母，獻皇帝為皇考，章聖皇太后為聖母。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingyin, it was settled that Xiaozong be called Imperial Uncle Father, Empress Dowager Zhaosheng be called Imperial Uncle Mother, Emperor Xian be called Imperial Father, and Empress Dowager Zhangsheng be called Holy Mother.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingyin, the court settled the Great Rites titles: Xiaozong as Imperial Uncle Father, Empress Dowager Zhaosheng as Imperial Uncle Mother, Emperor Xian as Imperial Father, and Empress Dowager Zhangsheng as Holy Mother.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔天下。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the decision was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，土魯番入寇，圍肅州。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Turfan raided and besieged Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Turfan raided and laid siege to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書金獻民總制軍務，署都督僉事杭雄充總兵官，太監張忠提督軍務，禦之。

translations.literal: Minister of War Jin Xianmin assumed overall direction of military affairs; Acting Regional Commander Hang Xiong served as overall commander; the eunuch Zhang Zhong supervised military affairs—to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Jin Xianmin took overall command; Acting Regional Commander Hang Xiong was appointed overall field commander; the eunuch Zhang Zhong directed operations against the invaders.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己卯，戶部侍郎胡瓚提督宣、大軍務，都督魯綱充總兵官，討大同叛卒。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on jimao, Vice Minister of Revenue Hu Zan supervised military affairs at Xuanfu and Datong; Regional Commander Lu Gang served as overall commander—to suppress the mutinous troops at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jimao, Vice Minister of Revenue Hu Zan took charge of the Xuanfu and Datong campaigns; Regional Commander Lu Gang was made overall commander to crush the mutineers at Datong.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，甘、涼寇退，召金獻民還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renzi, the raiders at Gan and Liang retreated; Jin Xianmin was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renzi, the raiders withdrew from Gan and Liang and Jin Xianmin was recalled.

sentences.zh: 戊午，起致仕大學士楊一清為兵部尚書，總制陝西三邊軍務。

translations.literal: On wuwu, retired Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing was raised up as Minister of War and assumed overall direction of military affairs on the three frontiers of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu retired Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing was recalled as minister of war and put in overall command of the three Shaanxi frontiers.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢，魯迷國貢獅子、犀牛。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu sent tribute, and Rum presented lions and rhinoceroses.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent tribute, and Rum sent lions and rhinoceroses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙寅，西海卜兒孩犯甘肅，總兵官姜奭擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on bingyin, the Boerhai of the Western Sea raided Gansu; Regional Commander Jiang Shi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourth year, on bingyin, the Boerhai of the Western Sea struck Gansu, and Regional Commander Jiang Shi drove them back.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，禁淹獄囚。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao, prolonged detention of prisoners in jail was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, an edict forbade keeping prisoners locked up indefinitely.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，仁壽宮災。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renwu, Renshou Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, Renshou Palace was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，賜廬州知府龍誥官秩，詔天下仿誥備荒振濟法。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on jiaxu, Luzhou Prefect Long Gao was granted an official rank; an edict ordered the realm to follow Gao's methods for granary storage, famine preparedness, and relief distribution.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiaxu of the fifth month, Luzhou Prefect Long Gao was granted an official rank, and an edict ordered the whole realm to adopt his methods for storing grain against famine and distributing relief.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，作世廟祀獻皇帝。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Imperial Shrine was built for sacrifices to Emperor Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Imperial Shrine was built to sacrifice to Emperor Xian.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，作仁壽宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi, Renshou Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi, Renshou Palace was constructed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，作玉德殿，景福、安喜二宮。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on dinghai, Yude Hall and the two palaces Jingfu and Anxi were built.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai, Yude Hall and the two palaces, Jingfu and Anxi, were built.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，《大禮集議》成，頒示天下。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, the Collected Deliberations on the Great Rites was completed and promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, the Collected Deliberations on the Great Rites was finished and promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary month, yimao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary month, yimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，振遼東災。

translations.literal: On yihai famine relief was extended to the Liaodong disaster region.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai famine relief was extended to the disaster-stricken Liaodong region.

sentences.zh: 是年，天方入貢。

translations.literal: That year Tianfang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came with tribute from Tianfang.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yiwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fifth year, on yiwei, the emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，命道士邵元節為真人。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiayin, the Daoist Shao Yuanjie was appointed True Man.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, the Daoist Shao Yuanjie was made a True Man.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，免山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On gengchen taxes and grain levies were remitted in disaster-stricken Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen taxes and grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，振京師饑。

translations.literal: On renwu famine relief was extended to the capital famine.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu famine relief was extended to the hungry capital.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，賜龔用卿等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinchou, Gong Yongqing and other metropolitan graduates were granted ranks as jinshi or chushen according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinchou, Gong Yongqing and other metropolitan graduates were granted jinshi and chushen ranks according to merit.

sentences.zh: 丁未，定有司久任法。

translations.literal: On dingwei regulations were set on long tenure for local officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei regulations were fixed on long tenure for local officials.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚子，楊一清復入閣。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on gengzi, Yang Yiqing again entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on gengzi of the fifth month, Yang Yiqing reentered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，免四川被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengyin, taxes and grain levies were remitted in disaster-stricken Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on gengyin of the seventh month, taxes and grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，振湖廣饑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingyin, famine relief was extended to Huguang famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin, famine relief was extended to the hungry in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，章聖皇太后有事于世廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jihai, Empress Dowager Zhangsheng performed rites at the Imperial Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jihai, Empress Dowager Zhangsheng performed rites at the Imperial Shrine.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥朔，親享如太廟禮。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, xinhai, the Emperor personally performed the sacrifice according to the rites of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, xinhai, the emperor personally performed the sacrifice according to the rites used at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬子，振南畿、浙江災，免稅糧物料。

translations.literal: On renzi famine relief was extended to the Southern Metropolitan Region and Zhejiang disasters, and taxes, grain levies, and material levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi famine relief was extended to the disasters in the Southern Metropolitan Region and Zhejiang, and taxes, grain levies, and material levies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚午，頒禦制《敬一箴》于學宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu the imperially composed Admonition on Reverent Unity was promulgated to the state academies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor's own Admonition on Reverent Unity was promulgated to the state academies.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came with tribute from Siam.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸未，命群臣陳民間利病。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on guiwei, the court ordered the ministers to set forth what benefited or harmed the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, on guiwei, the court ordered the ministers to report what helped or harmed the people.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On jichou the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，小王子犯宣府，參將王經戰死。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinhai, the Little Prince raided Xuanfu; Vice Commander Wang Jing died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinhai, the Little Prince struck Xuanfu, and Vice Commander Wang Jing was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，費宏、石珤致仕。

translations.literal: On guihai Fei Hong and Shi Bao retired.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Fei Hong and Shi Bao retired from office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，召謝遷復入閣。

translations.literal: On gengwu Xie Qian was recalled to reenter the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Xie Qian was recalled to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，寇復犯宣府，參將關山戰死。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, the raiders again struck Xuanfu; Vice Commander Guan Shan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengchen, the raiders again struck Xuanfu, and Vice Commander Guan Shan was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禮部侍郎翟鑾為吏部侍郎兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhai Luan, vice minister of rites, was made vice minister of personnel concurrent with Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhai Luan, vice minister of rites, was made vice minister of personnel concurrent with Hanlin academician, entered the Grand Secretariat, and took up deliberation of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，免廣西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on jisi, taxes and grain levies were remitted in disaster-stricken Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jisi of the fourth month, taxes and grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，前南京兵部尚書王守仁兼左都御史，總制兩廣、江西、湖廣軍務，討田州叛蠻。

translations.literal: On dinghai, former Minister of War at Nanjing Wang Shouren was additionally made Left Censor-in-Chief, put in overall command of military affairs in the Two Guangs, Jiangxi, and Huguang, and sent to campaign against the rebel tribes of Tianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai former Nanjing Minister of War Wang Shouren was additionally made left censor-in-chief, put in overall command of military affairs in the Two Guangs, Jiangxi, and Huguang, and sent to campaign against the rebel tribes of Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚戌，以議李福達獄，下刑部尚書顏頤壽、左都御史聶賢、大理寺卿湯沐等於錦衣衛獄，侍郎桂萼、張璁，少詹事方獻夫署三法司，雜治之。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on gengxu, because of deliberations on the Li Fuda case, Minister of Punishments Yan Yishou, Left Censor-in-Chief Nie Xian, Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Tang Mu, and others were sent to Jinyiwei prison; Vice Ministers Gui E and Zhang Cong and Junior Mentor Fang Xianfu were put in charge of the Three Judicial Offices and jointly tried the case.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on gengxu of the eighth month, because of the deliberations on the Li Fuda case, Minister of Punishments Yan Yishou, Left Censor-in-Chief Nie Xian, Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Tang Mu, and others were cast into Jinyiwei prison; Vice Ministers Gui E and Zhang Cong and Junior Mentor Fang Xianfu were put in charge of the Three Judicial Offices and jointly tried the case.

sentences.zh: 總制尚書王憲擊敗小王子于石臼墩。

translations.literal: Overall Commander Minister Wang Xian defeated the Little Prince at Shijiudun.
translations.idiomatic: Overall Commander Wang Xian defeated the Little Prince at Shijiudun.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賈詠致仕。

translations.literal: On guihai Jia Yong retired.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Jia Yong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，振湖廣水災。

translations.literal: On gengwu famine relief was extended for the Huguang flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu famine relief was extended to the flood-stricken in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，免江西、河南、山西被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jimao, autumn grain levies were remitted in disaster-stricken Jiangxi, Henan, and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao, autumn grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken Jiangxi, Henan, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，頒《欽明大獄錄》於天下。

translations.literal: On renwu the Record of the August and Illuminating Great Cases was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Record of the August and Illuminating Great Cases was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，兵部侍郎張璁為禮部尚書兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on wushen, Zhang Cong, vice minister of war, was made minister of rites concurrent with Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, Zhang Cong, vice minister of war, was made minister of rites concurrent with Wenyuan grand secretary and took up deliberation of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 是年，魯迷入貢。

translations.literal: That year Rum sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came with tribute from Rum.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸未，考核天下巡撫官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on guiwei, grand coordinators throughout the realm were evaluated.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the seventh year, on guiwei, grand coordinators throughout the realm were evaluated.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On bingxu the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，謝遷致仕。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuyin, Xie Qian retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, Xie Qian retired from office.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，右都御史伍文定為兵部尚書提督軍務，侍郎梁材督理糧儲，討雲南叛蠻。

translations.literal: On guisi, Right Censor-in-Chief Wu Wending was made Minister of War in charge of military affairs; Vice Minister Liang Cai supervised grain stores; they were sent to campaign against rebel tribes in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Right Censor-in-Chief Wu Wending was made minister of war in charge of military affairs, Vice Minister Liang Cai was put in charge of grain stores, and they were sent to campaign against rebel tribes in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，甘露降，告於郊廟。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiayin, sweet dew fell; the event was reported at the suburban altars and state temples.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiayin of the fourth month, sweet dew fell, and the event was reported at the suburban altars and state temples.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，《明倫大典》成，頒示天下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinchou, the Great Canon of Human Relations was completed and promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou, the Great Canon of Human Relations was finished and promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，定議禮諸臣罪，追削楊廷和等籍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinmao: Anda raided Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao, Anda raided Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，入雁門關。

translations.literal: Day renyin: he entered Yanmen Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he entered Yanmen Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁未，犯太原。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: he attacked Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he attacked Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day jiyou: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 夏言罷。

translations.literal: Xia Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 己未，俺答寇潞安，掠沁、汾、襄垣、長子，參將張世忠戰死。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Anda raided Lu'an, plundered Qin, Fen, Xiangyuan, and Changzi; Assistant Regional Commander Zhang Shizhong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Anda raided Lu'an, plundered Qin, Fen, Xiangyuan, and Changzi, and Assistant Regional Commander Zhang Shizhong was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，募兵于直隸、山東、河南。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi: troops were recruited in Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, troops were recruited in Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，振山西被兵州縣，免田租。

translations.literal: Day renwu: relief was extended to prefectures and counties in Shanxi harmed by the fighting; field rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu relief was sent to Shanxi prefectures and counties harmed by the fighting, and field rents were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禮部尚書嚴嵩兼武英殿大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Yan Song, Minister of Rites, was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Yan Song, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Wuying Hall and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，員外郎劉魁諫營雷殿，予杖下獄。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: Assistant Department Director Liu Kui remonstrated against building the Thunder Hall; he was beaten with the staff and cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai, Assistant Department Director Liu Kui remonstrated against building the Thunder Hall; he was beaten with the staff and cast into prison.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，宮人謀逆伏誅，磔端妃曹氏、甯嬪王氏於市。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingyou: palace women who plotted rebellion were executed; Consort Duan, née Cao, and Lady Wang of Ning were dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, palace women who plotted rebellion were executed; Consort Duan, née Cao, and Lady Wang of Ning were dismembered in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 是年，免畿內、陝西、河南、福建被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year, tax grain in disaster-stricken areas of the metropolitan region, Shaanxi, Henan, and Fujian was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken areas of the metropolitan region, Shaanxi, Henan, and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 安南入貢。

translations.literal: Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Annam sent a tribute mission.
